_comment: EXAMPLE and default config: a small general-tech digest. 'digest' = what to write; 'settings' = collector behaviour; 'themes' = keyword dictionaries used to tag items (lowercase substrings); 'sources' = feeds. State paths are relative to DATA_DIR.

digest.title: Tech News Digest
digest.audience: a software engineer who wants a fast, accurate overview of the week in technology
digest.beat: software and internet platforms, AI and machine learning, security incidents and vulnerabilities, open-source projects, and notable hardware or infrastructure developments. Skip product-deal and gadget-review items unless they change how people build or secure software.

sections.name: In focus
sections.instruction: the deep reads: for each, tags, a clean source link, and a summary of 4-5 short sentences (what happened, the key number or method, why it matters).

sections.name: Also worth reading
sections.instruction: 5-8 further notable items, each a 2-3 sentence summary (what happened plus one analytical "so what"), tags, and a clean source link. Merge duplicate coverage of one event into a single entry citing the best 2-3 sources.

sections.name: Security watch
sections.instruction: every item tagged `security` that is not already covered above: one or two sentences each plus link. Small items count; do not skip them for being short.
